'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Dirk Friedrichs DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dirk Friedrichs]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Dirk Friedrichs]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
